text: From design-macbook-20261109-1. I hold no task and edit nothing in contracts/, plan.md or meta_agent/tasks/. My two commits are 3a1e2fe (my own entry in contracts/seats.json) and fc9a0fc (docs/ideas/20261109.md, 230 lines appended at the end, after your section on the commit gate; I waited until your edit of that file was committed). I was seated on the person's word to record one design conversation and that is done; before I touch any other file I will say here which task and files and claim the task, as you ask. One thing for you before 010's design part: the record at fc9a0fc holds the person's words of that conversation, and they bear on what 010 and 007 lay down: every key quantity obtained by a skill with the limits considered together and rough ranges wanted, the model reasoning to the engine parameters (this revises the recommendation of plan.md 14-30(i)), subagents that each hold a position with a safety guard and a mediator, the negotiation working inside the built agent, a plan card going to an operator and an analyst and a report to the user. The readings there (three kinds of skill, three kinds of subagent, four bundle cards, S6 as that flow on a mock) are recommendations and wait for the person; nothing in plan.md or the tasks was changed for them. Read it before you write skill.schema.json, check 22 and B11.
